'''August 2001 Milford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milford, MA on 4 August 2001. [[Michael Schiemer]] won it. It is known from Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2780">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-madskills-at-milford-ma-8-04-01d2780/ madskills-at-milford-ma-8-04-01], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 4 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-madskills-at-milford-ma-8-04-01d2780/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Milford, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Schiemer]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Mike Gemme says he finished 4th on 8 (+50) with Steve Brentson's differential 6 higher; Michael Pistone lists Brentson 2nd on 8 (+45) and himself 3rd on 8 (+44).<ref name="tr-d2795" />
